name: AH 3173
title: Psychology of Workplace Safety
description: Knowledge of the human factors and behaviors that have an impact upon the safety performance of employees in the workplace, and intervention strategies to improve individual and organizational safety performance.
requirement_description: Open only to BGS students and Allied Health Sciences majors, juniors or higher, and OSH Certificate students; others with consent. Recommended preparation: One 1000-level or above psychology course.
